We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead large, complex, cross-functional engineering programs supporting Public Sector. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical depth, strategic program leadership, and the ability to communicate clearly at the VP/SVP/EVP level.

The Principal TPM must maintain working fluency in cloud architecture, distributed systems design, large-scale enterprise integration patterns, data flows, APIs/services, network engineering fundamentals, security, reliability, and modern SDLC/DevOps practices.

The Principal TPM converts business strategy into predictable engineering delivery, drives cross-value-stream alignment, manages critical dependencies and risks, and ensures executive stakeholders receive concise, decision-ready updates.

This is a remote opportunity for candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of large, complex, multi-team engineering programs, ensuring program structure, delivery rhythms, and engineering outcomes are clear and predictable.
Define and track performance metrics tied to engineering execution, program health, and SLAs with business and product stakeholders.
Develop and maintain engineering-aligned roadmaps, integrated timelines, dependency maps, budgets, and risk mitigation plans.
Build and lead program governance for executives, synthesizing engineering progress, risks, and technical trade-offs into clear, decision-oriented updates.
Implement best practices in engineering program governance, dependency management, cross-team risk visibility, SDLC alignment, and change management.
Foster a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and delivery predictability across engineering teams and partner groups.
Partner with finance, engineering, and product to monitor capital/opex, capacity utilization, and resource allocation across internal teams and vendors.
Report on program status including engineering risks, dependencies, integration concerns, and mitigation paths to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Coordinate engineering planning cycles (roadmap planning, PI planning, quarterly commitments) and ensure backlogs are prioritized, estimated, and aligned with program objectives.
Contribute to strategic planning and partner across Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Operations to ensure engineering readiness for launches and major releases.

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience; advanced degree is a plus.
12–15+ years of experience leading large-scale technical or engineering programs within complex, matrixed technology organizations.
Strong technical fluency in architecture, system design, APIs/services, data flows, and SDLC/DevOps.
Proven ability to communicate clearly and influence at the VP/SVP/EVP level—distilling complex engineering issues, risks, and trade-offs into concise recommendations.
Demonstrated experience managing engineering dependencies, sequencing across multiple teams, and driving outcomes across software and/or network domains.
Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve cross-team conflicts, and turn strategy into structured engineering execution plans.
Exceptional stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Finance.
High urgency, accountability, and operational rigor; sets high standards for clarity, delivery predictability, and tooling hygiene. PMP/PMI, Agile/SAFe, or Lean Six Sigma certifications are a plus.

In this role you will be the single point of accountability for ensuring each site runs as expected — SLAs met, maintenance executed on schedule, and audits passed — across a growing portfolio of landlord-operated and purpose-built facilities.

You will operate as the primary interface between Nebius and our data center landlords and operators, and you will partner closely with the Nebius IT team to translate site-level operations into reliable infrastructure for our customers.

Own the operational health of Nebius COLO and BTS sites, ensuring each facility runs to expectation across power, cooling, space, connectivity, security, and environmental controls.
Track, monitor, and enforce SLA compliance across landlords and colocation providers; identify breaches, drive remediation, and hold providers accountable to contractual commitments.
Manage and coordinate site maintenance schedules — preventive and corrective — including planning and approving maintenance windows, reviewing Methods of Procedure (MOPs), and minimizing risk to live workloads.
Plan and drive site audits covering compliance, capacity, power/cooling performance, physical security, and safety; track findings to closure.
Serve as the primary day-to-day interface with data center landlords and operators, managing the operational relationship, escalations, and coordination of on-site activity.
Partner closely with the Nebius IT team on deployments, capacity planning, incident response, and change management at each site.
Build reporting mechanisms and dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into site health, SLA performance, maintenance status, and open risk across the portfolio.
Lead incident coordination and post-incident follow-up, including root cause analysis and corrective action tracking with landlords and internal teams.
Track and manage contractual operational obligations, deliverables, and timelines across multiple sites and providers simultaneously.

The Data Center team is responsible for the physical infrastructure that underpins Nebius' AI cloud. We manage the full lifecycle of our COLO and BTS footprint — from bringing new capacity online to keeping live sites running reliably at scale.
